description: Get 2DEEP’s current supply, supply cap, float, Rewarder V3 balance, endowment locked, and outstanding migration liabilities, read live from chain. 2DEEP replaced DEEP and STATE in the DGP-3 upgrade on 2026-09-22, and every figure here reflects that migration: `state_to_2deep_wad`/`state_to_2deep` (1 STATE redeems for 3.0155 2DEEP; DEEP redeems 1:1), plus `legacy_deep_total_supply_raw`/`legacy_state_total_supply_raw`, the old tokens’ current total supplies (the DEEP figure includes about 793M DEEP stranded forever in the retired Rewarder V1, which can never be redeemed; for what’s actually still redeemable see 1s_ds_migration’s `remaining_deep_redeemable_raw`/`remaining_state_redeemable_raw`). `price_usdg`/`price_usdg_raw` come from the USDG/2DEEP Uniswap v4 pool and are omitted from the response until that pool has a trade; `price_source` still names the pool, so a client can tell "no price yet" from "wrong pool". There is no deadline to redeem old DEEP or STATE.
name: 1s_ds_token_2deep
title: Deepstate 2DEEP Token
